description: Who controls the company, followed up the register. The people-with-significant-control chain followed company by company while the controller is a UK-registered company (up to five levels) - each company's name, number, status and insolvency flag, what each controller holds, where the register ends (a foreign parent, a listed company, a PSC statement), and any trouble above. Individuals counted, never named.
name: ownership
title: Ownership Chain
